_about: Editor-verified fixes. Every fact here was re-read from the linked source on the verified_on date. Apply with: python3 scripts/apply_editorial.py editorial/2026-09-26.json

set.promise: Har ghar nal se jal — piped water to every rural household by 2024

changes.why: Both sources describe the goal as covering rural households (PIB release PRID 2002716; The Wire, 2 July 2023).

editorial.record: As of 30 January 2024, more than 14.21 crore of 19.27 crore rural households (73.76%) had tap water, a government progress report said.
editorial.summary: The Har Ghar Jal programme under the Jal Jeevan Mission aimed to give every rural household a tap water connection by 2024. Citing a report, The Wire said in July 2023 that the pandemic and the Russia-Ukraine war had delayed it. A Press Information Bureau release of 5 February 2024 said more than 14.21 crore of 19.27 crore rural households (73.76%) had tap water as of 30 January 2024, about 11 months before the end of 2024. This page does not yet cite a coverage figure from after that deadline.
